dialogues.speaker: Arezo
dialogues.text: I don't think I've ever seen you around here... Are you a new guest here?

dialogues.speaker: Arezo
dialogues.text: Oh me? I'm Arezo, and I'm... a former researcher in the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Arezo
dialogues.text: My younger brother Hosseini and I both got in the Akademiya, but I just couldn't get used to that kind of life...

dialogues.speaker: Arezo
dialogues.text: My younger brother seems to like it though, so he can do as he likes.

dialogues.speaker: Arezo
dialogues.text: Anyway, I gave up the life of a researcher and returned to this place, my hometown, to lead a life of comfort without any papers or report meetings!

dialogues.speaker: Arezo
dialogues.text: Alright, I hope you enjoy your stay here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: To be honest, I'm a little jealous.

dialogues.speaker: Arezo
dialogues.text: Jealousy won't make you any happier. If you have a dream, take actions and go for it.

dialogues.speaker: Arezo
dialogues.text: But it seems that you are in a hurry. I guess you're busy with something else, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Arezo
dialogues.text: It's okay. It rains and shines just as flowers bloom and fade. It's never too late to take a break once you've done what you have to do.
